biography.plain_text: Angela Cotter is an Irish property businesswoman and co-owner, with her husband Michael, of Park Developments. The Dublin group develops homes, commercial buildings and logistics parks. Her business interests also extend to Britain, where she has held a longstanding directorship of Ambleland, part of the family's established property company network.

long_biography.plain_text:
Angela Cotter helped make a larger stage possible for Ireland's women's hockey team. For the Olympic qualifier in 2019, she and fellow benefactor Susan Spence agreed to support the event if it failed to break even. Their backing allowed Hockey Ireland to approve a temporary pitch at Donnybrook, with more spectator space than the alternative venues.

Cotter has also supported the national women's programme through Park Developments. The company's bursary sponsorship enabled players to reduce their working hours and train together more often. It formed part of the funding that allowed overseas players to return to Ireland and compete on a semi-professional basis.
